assets.theme: Microperforated Star Foil on Midnight Cotton Card
assets.palette: midnight blue, warm champagne gold, muted graphite, soft paper black
assets.prompt: Purpose: Design a reusable premium Christmas print texture for a stationery art director, suitable for a wide corporate greeting banner and a luxury gift-packaging artwork with typography added later. Subject and material: Present one continuous sheet of deep midnight-blue cotton cardstock photographed almost straight on. Sparse miniature eight-point starbursts are formed by actual shallow blind impressions and tiny pin perforations; a few selected strokes catch imperfect champagne-gold foil transfer. Show believable paper fibers, minuscule foil skips, restrained indentation shadow, and pinholes that remain physically small. Composition: One horizontal 16:9 full-bleed surface. Keep a broad calm area across the left and center for future text while the small star clusters become slightly denser at the far right and upper edge. Avoid rigid repeated spacing or a centered motif. Art style: Luxury Foil Letterpress Macro Photography, tactile matte card, restrained metallic glints, coherent real material scale. Lighting: Broad diffused studio side light with soft relief shadows and no harsh glare. Constraints: No text, numbers, brand marks, watermark, holiday illustration, floating stickers, fake transparent background, or unverified seamless tile claim.
assets.negative_prompt: glitter confetti, logos, lettering, pasted star stickers, uniform digital dots, seamless-pattern claims

assets.theme: Brushed Metallic Tinsel Filament Border on Dark Slate

assets.prompt: Purpose: Provide a reusable understated Christmas edge decoration for a retail designer creating mobile stories and a seasonal catalogue page. Each strand rests on the card with a believable contact shadow. Composition: Portrait 9:16 full-frame photographic design component. Confine tinsel to the far right quarter and a small section of the lower corner. Maintain a generously quiet left-center field for later offer copy; protect upper and lower margins for mobile interface overlays. Avoid a decorative frame on all four sides. Art style: Studio Tinsel Fiber Macro Photography with natural irregular spacing, tactile card grain, coherent metallic reflections and selective depth. Lighting: Soft controlled side illumination, no blown white specular patches. Constraints: One original raster backdrop, no lettering, brands, watermarks, glitter clouds, fake alpha transparency, or repeated tinsel stamp effects.

assets.theme: Gingerbread Crust Relief with Sparse Coarse Sugar

Concentrate the more noticeable pressed relief on the right third, leaving the left-central area quieter for editorial typography and adaptable crops. Keep true food scale, no artificial tiling or enlarged sugar crystals. Art style: Macro Artisan Bakery Surface Photography, precise crumb detail, warm natural texture, restrained color grading. Lighting: Gentle diffuse overhead daylight with low-angle texture relief and warm shadows. Constraints: Original texture only, no lettering, logos, watermark, invented food symbols or seamless-pattern claim.
